# VocabWize

> Word Definitions, Meanings & Comparisons

Look up definitions, meanings, and usage for 160,000+ English words. Compare confusing words side by side.

## Core pages
- [Methodology and data sources](https://vocabwize.com/methodology/): how every figure is derived, with primary-source citations
- [Words directory](https://vocabwize.com/word/): browse every word we cover
- [Rankings](https://vocabwize.com/rankings/): words ranked by the key metric
- [Compare](https://vocabwize.com/compare/): side-by-side comparison
- [About and editorial standards](https://vocabwize.com/about/): authorship and review policy

## Data
- Primary sources: ECDICT, Princeton WordNet, COCA, ECDICT (English-Chinese Dictionary)
- All figures are derived from these primary sources; see /methodology/ for derivation and vintage.
